proof_body:
by
  intro n _ K _ _ _ h2
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot (S := {n}) ℚ K rfl (NeZero.ne n)
  have h0 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.IsPrimitiveRoot.nrRealPlaces_eq_zero_of_two_lt h2 hζ
  have h1 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K
  have h3 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces (K := K)
  have h4 := NumberField.Units.finrank_eq K
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card (NumberField.InfinitePlace K) := Fintype.card_pos
  have h5 := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.finrank (k := n) K
  rw [NumberField.Units.rank] at h4
  omega
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K], 2 < n → 2 * (Module.finrank ℤ (Additive (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ) + 1) = n.totient
